_format: Fixed-date commemorations (Menaion) on the New (Revised Julian) Calendar. Each entry: 'Name — subtitle #rank @slug'. #great = one of the Twelve Great Feasts, #major = red-letter feast or great saint. @slug links to a saint page (shared across dates). Compiled from the standard Greek/Slavic Synaxarion; verify against goarch.org/chapel/calendar before publishing.
